project_description:
The idea sells itself. A storybook where a child is the hero. Parents buy millions of them every year. The product never lives up to the premise. Same template storyline with a name swapped in. Generic illustrations that look nothing like the kid. A princess adventure for a five-year-old who only cares about dinosaurs. Three reads, then the drawer.

I wanna create a storybook creator that takes in the likeness of a child so they can see themselves in the story, and then also allow the illustrations to be the child, based on their preferences or what they like. dinosaurs, ninjas, etc.
